title: fix: use httpClient on retry raw containerfile fetch
body:
Fixes #7196

#### What type of PR is this?

> /kind bug

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

Fix the issue mentioned in #7196:

> downloadToDirectory (pkg/tmpdir/url.go) builds an HTTP client from URLOptions and fetches the URL.
> It first tries to untar the response. If the body is a plain Containerfile rather than a tarball, the untar fails and the URL is fetched a second time.
> That second fetch uses http.DefaultClient instead of the configured httpClient, so the TLS and proxy
> options from the command line don't apply to it.

#### How to verify it

```bash
bats tests/bud.bats -f bud-insecure-https-context
```

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes #7196
